name: ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base
license: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base Model License Agreement v1.0
archDisplay: Pretrained MoE base (no mid- or post-training): 43 layers (1 dense + 42 Multi-Router Latent MoE, 512 routed experts top-10 + 1 shared), hybrid attention (37 heavily compressed + 6 MLA with sparse attention), 33.5T tokens; 128K training context, 1M for fine-tuning and inference
note: Baidu's first ERNIE 5.5 release, published November 5, 2026: the checkpoint at the end of pre-training, released before any mid- or post-training as a starting point for fine-tuning and RL research. FP8 and BF16 safetensors on Hugging Face under Baidu's own ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base Model License Agreement v1.0; Baidu says the post-trained ERNIE 5.5 Flash will follow. Scores are few-shot base-model evaluations. Not filed: GPQA (5-shot, subset not stated), SimpleQA (10-shot base prompt, not the chat protocol), MMMLU-lite and INCLUDE-lite (subsets), RepoBench 50.3 (above the column's bound), and rows with no column (ChineseSimpleQA, PreciseWikiQA, HotpotQA, PopQA, MathBench-CN, MultiLoKo, FullStackBench, HELMET, RepoQA, LongBench v2, InfiniteBench).
